summary_para_1: Explosion at Al-Ahli Baptist Hospital compound where thousands of displaced Palestinians were sheltering. Massive casualties in hospital courtyard.

author: aliattia02
summary_para_1: Massive airstrike on densely populated Jabalia refugee camp. Entire residential blocks destroyed. Israel admitted targeting Hamas commander.

author: aliattia02
summary_para_1: Israeli forces opened fire on Palestinians waiting for food aid distribution. Hundreds of civilians killed and injured while trying to obtain flour.

author: aliattia02
summary_para_1: Series of attacks on UNRWA schools serving as shelters for displaced Palestinians. Multiple schools hit despite UN coordination with Israeli forces.

event_name: Mass Graves Discovery at Nasser Hospital
author: aliattia02
summary_para_1: Mass graves discovered at Nasser Hospital after Israeli withdrawal. Bodies found with hands tied, evidence of executions. Some bodies taken from hospital by Israeli forces.

author: aliattia02
summary_para_1: Israeli forces besieged Gaza's largest hospital, cutting off power and water. Patients died due to lack of medical care. Hospital raided despite being protected under international law.

author: aliattia02
summary_para_1: Israeli airstrike on tent camp sheltering displaced Palestinians in Rafah. Many victims burned alive in their tents. Israel claimed targeting Hamas operatives.

author: aliattia02
summary_para_1: Israeli forces targeted and killed seven World Central Kitchen aid workers in three consecutive strikes on clearly marked vehicles. International outcry followed.

author: aliattia02
summary_para_1: Systematic destruction of entire neighborhoods in Gaza City. Thousands of buildings reduced to rubble. Mass displacement of population.

author: aliattia02
summary_para_1: Complete blockade of northern Gaza including Jabalia, Beit Hanoun, and Beit Lahiya. No food, water, or medical supplies allowed. Use of starvation as method of warfare.
